quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #14
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: What should you do when you see a flashing yellow light at an intersection?

options.text: Slow down and proceed with care.
Continue normally through the intersection.
Stop and wait for a green light.
Stop and proceed when the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with care.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means caution. Slow down, look both ways, and proceed carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Winding road.
No parking.
Right lane closed.
Multiple turns.

questions.correctAnswerText: Winding road.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road ahead has curves. Slow down and be ready to adjust your speed.

questions.question: What must you do when an emergency vehicle with lights and/or siren approaches you?

options.text: Pull to the right and stop.
Pull to the right and slow down.
Pull to the right and turn on your four-way flashers.
Stop and let the emergency vehicle pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull to the right and stop.
questions.explanation: When an emergency vehicle with lights and/or siren approaches, immediately drive to the right side of the road and stop.

questions.question: What should a driver do if they are worried, nervous, angry, or upset?

options.text: Drive as normal because emotions do not affect driving.
Drive faster because strong emotions improve focus.
Calm down and focus before starting the car.
Call a friend to talk while driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Calm down and focus before starting the car.
questions.explanation: Strong emotions can distract you from driving. Take time to calm down and focus before you start driving.

questions.question: What does an arrow painted on the road mean?

options.text: Drivers in that lane may move in the direction of the arrow if they choose to.
Drivers in that lane must move in the direction of the arrow only if traffic lights are broken.
Drivers in that lane must always stop before moving in the direction of the arrow.
Drivers in that lane must move in the direction of the arrow while obeying traffic signals.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers in that lane must move in the direction of the arrow while obeying traffic signals.
questions.explanation: An arrow on the road tells you that you must move in that direction. Follow traffic signals and signs before moving in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: Where is it illegal to pass another vehicle?

options.text: On hills and curves.
At intersections.
At railroad crossings.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: You cannot pass on hills, curves, at intersections, or at railroad crossings. These areas are unsafe for passing.

questions.question: As alcohol builds up in your blood, what happens?

options.text: Your reaction time slows down.
You feel less confident.
Your body breaks down alcohol faster.
You make fewer driving mistakes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your reaction time slows down.
questions.explanation: As alcohol builds up in your system, your reactions slow down, you feel overly confident, and you make more errors.

questions.question: Where should your car be positioned before making a right turn?

options.text: Near the center of the street.
Close to the left side of the street.
Close to the right side of the street.
Past the center of the intersection when starting to turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Close to the right side of the street.
questions.explanation: Before turning right, move your car as far to the right as possible. Do not cut across other lanes.

questions.question: What does a flashing yellow traffic light mean?

options.text: Merging traffic ahead.
Proceed with caution.
Pedestrians are crossing.
Come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light tells you to drive carefully and be alert.

questions.question: What do diagonal stripes sloping downward and to the right on a barricade mean?

options.text: Stop.
Move to the right.
Move to the left.
Drive straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to the right.
questions.explanation: Diagonal stripes on a barricade guide you in the correct direction. Stripes sloping down and to the right mean move right. Stripes sloping down and to the left mean move left.

questions.question: A good defensive driver:

options.text: Always drives slowly.
Watches what other drivers do.
Drives at the same speed all the time.
Only drives on roads they know well.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watches what other drivers do.
questions.explanation: A defensive driver watches other drivers and expects problems. This helps you avoid crashes, even when other drivers make mistakes.

questions.question: When driving in fog, use your:

options.text: Low beam headlights.
High beam headlights.
Parking lights.
Hazard flashers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Low beam headlights.
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights in fog. High beams bounce off fog and make it harder to see. Use fog lights if your car has them.

questions.question: ____ greatly increase stopping distance and crash severity.

options.text: High speeds
Slow speeds
Driving at night
Driving uphill

questions.correctAnswerText: High speeds
questions.explanation: High speeds make it harder to stop and cause worse crashes. The faster you drive, the greater the force if you hit something.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: All traffic must turn.
Turn right at the intersection.
Parking area ahead.
A crossroad is ahead. Watch for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: A crossroad is ahead. Watch for traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is coming.

questions.question: What do speed limit signs show?

options.text: Possible speeds for the area
The fastest or slowest speed you are allowed to drive
The speed to drive in heavy traffic
The speed to drive in bad weather

questions.correctAnswerText: The fastest or slowest speed you are allowed to drive
questions.explanation: Speed limit signs show the fastest and slowest legal speeds. These limits are for good conditions. You must drive slower when conditions are bad.

questions.question: Before changing lanes, you should:

options.text: Check your side mirror.
Check your rearview mirror.
Turn your head quickly to check for vehicles.
Do all of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do all of the above.
questions.explanation: Check both mirrors and turn your head to look before changing lanes. This helps you see all vehicles around you, including those in your blind spots.

questions.question: Two solid white lines across a traffic lane mark a crosswalk. You should know that:

options.text: Vehicles have the right-of-way over people in crosswalks.
People in crosswalks have the right-of-way.
No one has the right-of-way in a crosswalk.
People must stay out of the way of all traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: People in crosswalks have the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: Crosswalk lines show people where to safely cross. You must always stop for people in a crosswalk.

questions.question: When backing up, you should:

options.text: Use only your mirrors.
Flash your lights.
Open your door to see what is behind.
Turn your head and look through the rear window.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your head and look through the rear window.
questions.explanation: Always look behind your vehicle before backing. Turn your head to see through the rear window. Mirrors and sensors alone are not enough.

questions.question: Signs for public recreation areas are:

options.text: Orange.
Red.
Green.
Brown.

questions.correctAnswerText: Brown.
questions.explanation: Brown signs show recreation areas and historical sites. They help you find places to visit.

questions.question: If a train is close or moving fast enough to be dangerous, you must:

options.text: Slow down and continue with care.
Wait until the train completely passes.
Cross the tracks at your own risk.
Find another route across the tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until the train completely passes.
questions.explanation: Look and listen for trains before crossing railroad tracks. If a train is near or moving fast, do not cross. Wait until it completely passes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians are walking on the road ahead.
A pedestrian crossing is ahead.
Pedestrians cannot cross here.
Construction workers are on the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A pedestrian crossing is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a pedestrian crossing is coming. Drivers should slow down and be ready for people crossing the road.

questions.question: Two vehicles arrive at a four-way stop at the same time. What should happen?

options.text: The vehicle on the left must let the vehicle on the right go first.
The vehicle on the right must let the vehicle on the left go first.
Drivers should use hand signals to communicate.
One driver should go without stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle on the left must let the vehicle on the right go first.
questions.explanation: At a four-way stop, vehicles go in order of arrival. If two vehicles arrive at the same time, the one on the left must yield to the one on the right.

questions.question: You see a sign that says "Reduced speed, 35 mph." What does this mean?

options.text: The 35 mph speed limit starts at this sign.
The 35 mph speed limit starts at the next speed limit sign.
You have plenty of time to slow down before the reduced speed zone.
You should only reduce your speed to 35 mph in bad weather.

questions.correctAnswerText: The 35 mph speed limit starts at this sign.
questions.explanation: "Reduced speed" signs tell drivers to slow down. The new speed limit begins right at the sign.

questions.question: What usually causes hydroplaning?

options.text: Making too many stops.
Stopping suddenly.
Turning suddenly.
Driving too fast.

questions.correctAnswerText: Driving too fast.
questions.explanation: At high speeds, tires cannot push water off the road. Your tires lose grip and the vehicle slides on water. This is hydroplaning.

questions.question: Which statement about drowsy drivers is true?

options.text: Strong black coffee will keep them awake.
They can drive so badly that they look drunk.
Opening a window and turning up the radio will keep them alert.
Only older drivers get drowsy while driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: They can drive so badly that they look drunk.
questions.explanation: Drowsy drivers can drive so poorly that they appear to be drunk. Coffee, open windows, and loud music are not enough to keep a drowsy driver safe and alert.
